visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female main character wearing a vibrant neon green ski suit, a white helmet, and a black face mask stands in a heavily snowy environment. She is speaking directly to the camera in a selfie-style shot. The background is a whiteout of falling snow and distant, blurred mountain slopes. (2) The woman walks toward a grey ticket vending machine in a modern transit or resort hub. She uses her gloved hand to interact with a touch screen displaying pricing options. A paper ticket is dispensed from the slot. The lighting is bright and indoor-artificial. (3) The camera follows the woman as she enters a glass-walled gondola. Inside, she places her snowboard, which has a "HINTER STODER" sticker, on the floor. Through the gondola windows, a panoramic view of a snow-covered alpine forest and misty mountains unfolds under a bright sky. (4) Multiple wide-angle shots depict a sprawling ski resort with groomed slopes. The woman is seen snowboarding down a gentle incline, wearing the same neon green suit. The weather has transitioned to a bright, sunny day with clear visibility of jagged, snow-capped mountain peaks. (5) The scene shifts to a warm, rustic indoor restaurant with wooden walls. The woman holds a white plate filled with golden-brown fried chicken wings. She takes a bite and smiles, expressing her enjoyment. A glass of bubbly clear soda is also visible on the table. (6) The woman is back on the snowy slopes, pointing toward a distant, steeper mountain peak. She is then shown using a yellow brush to vigorously clean snow off her white and pink patterned snowboard. The sun is lower in the sky, creating long shadows on the snow. (7) A final sequence from inside the cable car shows a serene sunset over the mountain range. The sky is a gradient of blue, pink, and orange. Text overlays appear to signify the end of the skiing trip. The character gives a thumbs-up gesture toward the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the woman's clear, high-pitched voice, sounding excited and energized. The background features a muffled wind noise consistent with an outdoor snowy environment. A soft, upbeat acoustic guitar BGM starts playing at a moderate volume, providing a cheerful atmosphere. (2) As the scene transitions to the ticket machine, the BGM continues. A distinct mechanical "ding" or notification sound is heard when the ticket is dispensed. The ambient noise floor shifts to a slightly echoey indoor space with distant, low-level chatter from other people. (3) Inside the cable car, there is a prominent mechanical whirring sound and the rhythmic clunking of the gondola passing over support towers. The woman's voice has a slightly contained resonance due to the enclosed glass space. The BGM remains steady with a light percussive beat. (4) On the ski slopes, the acoustic environment is dominated by the crisp, percussive "swish" and "crunch" of snowboards carving through frozen snow. These transient impact sounds are sharp and high-bandwidth. The woman's voice is louder as she shouts with joy, competing with wind gusts. (5) In the restaurant, the soundscape changes to a busy indoor "hubbub" consisting of clinking cutlery, glass sounds, and a thick bed of crowd chatter. The BGM is still audible but feels more like a radio playing in the background. The sound of a soda fountain pouring is clearly heard. (6) Back outdoors, the sound of the yellow brush bristles scrubbing the wooden/composite surface of the snowboard creates a repetitive, scratchy friction noise. The wind noise returns as the dominant ambient floor, punctuated by the woman's final enthusiastic remarks.
